variant.title: Arrow Sudoku
variant.description: Each arrow circle equals the sum of the digits on its path.
rule.arrow_sum: The arrow circle must equal the sum of its path.
rule_guide.title: Arrow Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Each arrow circle must equal the sum of the digits along its arrow path.
